title: Achieving Sub-Zeptonewton Force Sensitivity and Spin-Motion Entanglement in Levitated Diamond via Pulsed Backaction Evasion
summary: We propose a system to achieve sub-zeptonewton force sensing and robust spin-mechanical entanglement in a levitated diamond system. By coupling a nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center spin to the motion of its host diamond within a magnetic trap, we develop a platform designed to surpass the standard quantum limit. We develop and compare three distinct pulse sequences -- Ramsey, Hahn echo, and Carr-Purcell-Meiboom-Gill (CPMG) -- to create increasing amounts of backaction evasion while mitigating the effects of shot noise and thermal decoherence.
